How to order

Three easy steps to your cake

No sign-ups and no waiting on hold. Build your order here and send it straight to the bakery.

  1. Pick your treats

    Browse cakes in 1, 2 or 3 pound sizes and fresh bakery snacks, then add your favourites to the cart.

  2. Add your details

    Tell us your name, pickup or delivery, the date you need it and any message you would like on the cake.

  3. Send & confirm

    Send the order on WhatsApp. The bakery confirms availability, timing and the final price with you.

Celebrating something special?

Add a name or message for your cake in the cart. The bakery will confirm every detail with you before baking.
